heading: Storybook FAQ 📚
subtext: Answers to the questions parents ask most.

faqs.q: What age groups does Kaylan Preschool accept?
faqs.a: We welcome children from 1.5 to 5.5 years across Playgroup, Nursery, Junior KG and Senior KG.
A Montessori-inspired approach combined with the structured Kreedo curriculum for Maths, English and holistic development.
Yes! Full-day daycare is available with nap time, meals and enriching activities.

faqs.q: How do I book a school tour?
faqs.a: Simply click 'Book a School Tour' or WhatsApp us — we'll schedule a visit at your convenience.
